name: scene-to-art-lab
title_zh: 把一张照片变成七种画派的竖版艺术海报
tagline_zh: 水彩、波普、水墨、浮雕……你随手拍的街景，一键重绘成策展级 3:4 海报。不靠滤镜，靠风格引擎重画。
tagline_en: Turn a casual snapshot into a curated 3:4 poster—watercolor, pop, ink-wash, relief. Real redrawing, not filters.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photograph into an original vertical 3:4 art-directed poster using watercolor, pop-art screenprint, expressive painting, ink-wash, relief print, editorial surrealism, or a controlled hybrid. Use when the user asks to reinterpret a real scene, portrait, object, vehicle, landscape, architecture, or travel photo as creative visual art, an exhibition poster, editorial poster,
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是按画派语法重建构图与笔触；支持七种风格及受控混合，输出自带艺术指导的成品。
why_en: Rebuilds composition and strokes per art movement, not just color grading. Seven styles plus controlled hybrids, output is.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不吃多图合成；输出固定 3:4 竖版，横图会裁切；风格限定七种，超出即停；不修脸不磨皮。
limit_en: Single photo input only; fixed 3:4 vertical output (wide shots get cropped); limited to 7 styles; no face retouching—portraits are stylized.
